name: Your Stalker, Jayce Blackwood
source:
It's a late winter's night and you are cornered by a strange man who claims to know you. Claims that you know him. Claims that he saved you.

He wants you. Your body. Your soul. Your mind.

Will you submit to him? Or resist?

Either way, you [i]will[/i] be his.

[From [url=https://p1nk-ang3l.itch.io/your-stalker-jayce-blackwood]itch.io[/url]]
